sources.name: p_schoolexpenses_s
sources.script:
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~> p_schoolexpenses_s

typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared p_schoolexpenses_s = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parquet/p_schoolexpenses_s.parquet"), Parquet = Parquet.Document(AdfDoc) in Parquet;
shared UserQuery = let Source = #"p_schoolexpenses_s",
  
    #"Selected Columns" =  
        Table.SelectColumns(Source,{  
            "amount_paid",  
            "date_paid",
            "fin_type",  
            "recordid",  
            "school_id",
            "fin_code",  
            "month", 
            "year",  
            "first_name",  
            "last_name"  
        }),  
  
    #"Added Description" =  
        Table.AddColumn(  
            #"Selected Columns",  
            "description",  
            each   
                (if [first_name] = null then "" else Text.From([first_name]))   
                & " " &   
                (if [last_name] = null then "" else Text.From([last_name])),  
            type text  
        ),  
  
    // ✅ Add column WITHOUT declaring type  
    #"Added TranType" =  
        Table.AddColumn(  
            #"Added Description",  
            "TranType",  
            each 301220002  
        ),  
  
    // ✅ Set type in separate step (Spark safe)  
    #"Changed Type" =  
        Table.TransformColumnTypes(  
            #"Added TranType",  
            {{"TranType", Int64.Type}}  
        ),  
  
    #"Removed Unnecessary Columns" =  
        Table.RemoveColumns(#"Changed Type",{"first_name","last_name"}),  
  
    #"Renamed Columns" =  
        Table.RenameColumns(#"Removed Unnecessary Columns",{  
            {"amount_paid", "tcbgrow_amount"},  
            {"date_paid", "tcbgrow_asofdate"},
            {"fin_type", "tcbgrow_description"},  
            {"fin_code", "tcbgrow_source"},
            {"recordid", "tcbgrow_importexpenseid"},  
            {"school_id", "tcbgrow_importschoolid"},  
            {"month", "tcbgrow_month"},  
            {"year", "tcbgrow_year"},  
            {"description", "tcbgrow_description"},  
            {"TranType", "tcbgrow_transactiontype"}  
        }),
  #"Changed column type" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Renamed Columns", {{"tcbgrow_year", type text}})  
  
in  
    #"Changed column type";
